title: SailPoint is acquiring Entro Security, which develops a cybersecurity platform for managing non-human identities, a source says in a deal valued at ~$200M (Meir Orbach/CTech)
summary: Meir Orbach / CTech: SailPoint is acquiring Entro Security, which develops a cybersecurity platform for managing non-human identities, a source says in a deal valued at ~$200M — Acquisition strengthens SailPoint's push into the fast-growing market for securing non-human identities.
